doc.name: kernora-agent-security
doc.instructions: Kernora Agent Security gives your agent a security baseline. Call get_security_baseline for the full known-good set, or check_action before a risky command. Advisory only — upgrade to Kernora Axiora for real-time blocking + attested audit ledger.

tools.name: get_security_baseline

tools.name: check_action
